fields.title: Press every control on every screen and report what breaks
fields.description: A CDP-driven sweep (`scripts/ui-sweep/sweep.mjs`) presses every clickable control on every screen of a `--dir` build of 47ae6e1f, on a scratch profile, and reports each press as OK, ERROR, NO-EFFECT or skipped, with evidence. Bug candidates are filed by the planner.
fields.notes: Created 2026-10-23 by Blurby.Roadmap at the owner's request ("are you testing every button?"). Full Spec (U9/U10 pass). Dispatched 2026-10-23 to an implementation agent (blurby-6b; branch eb/ui-sweep-1). Live run waits for the Stage 8 smoke agent to finish. Not a release gate.
